name: DiffTinder
tagline: Swipe yes/no on daily speculative ideas for the monorepo.
description: Internal admin app: one new repo idea per day (cron-generated), admins swipe to approve or reject. Uses cookie login (ADMIN_PANEL_PASSWORD) instead of browser HTTP Basic Auth.

env_vars.description: Shared password for difftinder (and other panel) login — set once in admin Env.
Optional HMAC secret for session cookies (defaults to CRON_RUNNER_SECRET).
Bearer token for cron-runner POST /api/internal/daily-idea (defaults to CRON_RUNNER_SECRET).
Same token as Agitweet — on swipe yes, DiffTinder POSTs the idea to Agitweet (internal URL http://agitweet:5000).
